scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build:android: cd android && JAVA_HOME="$HOME/.jdk17/Contents/Home" ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && mkdir -p frontend/public/downloads storage/downloads && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk frontend/public/downloads/sahaaye-latest.apk && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk storage/downloads/sahaaye-latest.apk
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit --project backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project frontend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project shared/tsconfig.json
